# How many children does your center need to break even?

> Free break-even calculator for childcare centers and daycares: enter classrooms, licensing ratios, tuition, wages and rent to see monthly profit, break-even enrollment, the ratio cliffs where one more child costs a teacher, and the tuition increase needed. Runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
